- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested artists to follow for portrait painting:

  - Becca McHaffie (watercolor artist specializing in portraits)
  - Lorraine McAllister (Scottish watercolor artist)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for portrait painting include:

  - Use high-quality reference images
  - Experiment with different mediums
  - Focus on capturing the likeness
